threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts the synced student folders (the encrypted copies sync to cloud storage) and steals student folders and the portal password spreadsheet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop unencrypted and shared with family under one account; no MFA on email; desktop sync is the only copy besides 30-day version history; no backup sync cannot overwrite; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 laptop; SYS-01 student folders; BP-05
existing_controls: Automatic updates; built-in antivirus; 30-day version history
treatment_plan: Separate family account; disk encryption; MFA on every account; delete the password spreadsheet; independent backup of student folders; P08 runbook; security course

threat_event: Takeover of the email and files suite account exposes every student folder, the portal password spreadsheet, and parent email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the account, which is also the suite administrator; two reused passwords; folders shared by open links
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA now; unique passphrases in a password manager; replace open links with named-parent sharing

threat_event: Takeover of the website-builder administrator account exposes children's portal content (work photos, reading audio, messages) or lets an attacker message children
threat_source: Cybercriminal (credential stuffing against the public admin sign-in)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrator sign-in is password only; the former designer's collaborator account stayed active until 2026-07-16; 27 inactive member accounts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 website and student portal; BP-03
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; close inactive member accounts; review collaborators and members each term; obtain written security assurances from the builder

threat_event: Theft or loss of the unencrypted laptop exposes synced student folders, IEP and 504 plans, and evaluations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No full-disk encryption; laptop travels to students' homes and the library
treatment_plan: Turn on the built-in full-disk encryption; 5-minute lock; recovery key in the password manager and sealed envelope

threat_event: FTC finds the portal collects children's personal information without the required notices and informed parental consent, or keeps it without a retention policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No online notice (312.4(d)); enrollment agreement lacks direct notice content (312.4(c)(1)); audio added without new consent; no written retention policy (312.10); no written security program before 2026-07-31
existing_controls: Parent e-signature and card payment before a portal account is created
treatment_plan: Post the 312.4(d) notice; send a new direct notice and collect fresh consent from every portal family before the fall term; adopt the retention schedule; turn off portal analytics

threat_event: Student information pasted into a consumer AI assistant is kept by the vendor or used to train its models, without parent consent or written assurances
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free personal account; terms allow model improvement use; history on; student first names, scores, and accommodations in prompts since March 2026
treatment_plan: Stop entering student information; delete history and request deletion; business-tier tool with no-training terms only for de-identified drafting; owner decides placements (P10)

threat_event: A breach reaches far more children than needed because records of former students and inactive portal accounts were never deleted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention policy; folders of about 210 former students since 2019; 27 inactive portal accounts; recordings kept indefinitely; old laptop in a drawer
treatment_plan: Adopt the POL-01 retention schedule; purge records past their period; wipe the old laptop; turn on automatic recording deletion

threat_event: A family member using the shared laptop account installs malware, opens student files, or deletes them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Family members browse and install games under the owner's user account with access to synced student folders
treatment_plan: Separate family device or standard user account with no business files; business account for the owner only

threat_event: An attacker uses the default router admin password or a weak smart-home device to reach the laptop on the home network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default router admin password; family and smart-home devices on one network
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; router and host firewalls on
treatment_plan: Unique router admin password; smart-home devices on the guest network

threat_event: Cloud recordings of online sessions are exposed through the video account or kept after families withdraw; some were made without all-party consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the video account; no deletion schedule; consent checkbox not always ticked
existing_controls: Recordings only for families who asked
treatment_plan: MFA; 30-day automatic deletion; record only with a confirmed consent on file and a spoken reminder at the start

threat_event: Texts with parents and photos of student work on the personal phone are disclosed (lost phone, wrong recipient, or personal photo cloud)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Progress texts by ordinary SMS; work photos sync to a personal photo cloud
existing_controls: Phone passcode and biometric; phone encrypted
treatment_plan: Progress messages through the client-management SaaS; turn off photo sync for work photos and move them to student folders; remote wipe on

threat_event: Owner-tutor is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so no one can tell families or reach the accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; second factors on one phone; no emergency contact arrangement
treatment_plan: Sealed emergency sheet and recovery codes with a designated family member; backup-tutor agreement for SAT and ACT students (P05)

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the Florida 30-day notice deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; no cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; walk it through with the IT technician; get a cyber insurance quote

threat_event: Client-management SaaS outage lasts longer than one school day
existing_controls: Vendor recovery commitments (SOC 2, P09); printed weekly schedule
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep printing the weekly schedule and parent contact sheet each Sunday

threat_event: Hurricane or long power outage stops sessions for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home office; sessions depend on home power and internet
existing_controls: All business data is in SaaS reachable from any location; phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Tell families before a storm; move sessions after the storm
